transcript: Speaker A (Driver): Sir, why are you coming from the wrong side? You could have come under my tyre. Speaker B (Biker): Mind your own business, budhhe. Speaker A (Driver): Are these your manners talking like this to a man twice your age? This is specially made for people like us. I practice daily for just 10-15 minutes by talking to the AI teacher Vani.
